description: Hand-curated ground-truth dataset for customer support email categorization & summarization.

testCases.inputText: Hi team, I noticed a duplicate charge of $29.99 on my credit card statement for invoice #9812. Please issue a refund.
testCases.expectedSummary: Customer requested a $29.99 refund for duplicate invoice charge.

testCases.inputText: thx for charging me twice for 1 month service super awesome work guys
testCases.expectedSummary: Customer sarcastically reported being double-charged for monthly service.
testCases.notes: Sarcastic tone with lowercase/abbreviations. LLM judge must not mistake sarcasm for praise.

testCases.inputText: My login password reset link expired, and now when I try to log in, it says my billing account is locked.
testCases.expectedSummary: User locked out due to expired password reset and locked billing account.
testCases.notes: Spans both Account Access and Billing. Primary issue is login lockout.

testCases.inputText: App crash on iOS 18 after tapping settings
testCases.expectedSummary: iOS 18 app crashes when navigating to settings menu.
testCases.notes: Ultra-short input without greeting or signature.

testCases.inputText: Hola, I cannot access my dashboard. El sistema dice error 403 authorization failed.
testCases.expectedSummary: User getting 403 authorization error when accessing dashboard.
